instructions: Materialise each fixture in a separate temporary directory. Give an independent agent the copied skill, fixture and request. cases.request: I am starting a Python ADK catalogue agent. Before adding the agent or database client, implement a small reusable preview helper for already-fetched dictionary rows: at most 20 rows, 64 columns and 1,000 characters per cell, with an exact 64 KiB UTF-8 JSON payload ceiling. Preserve the input and expose truncation explicitly. Use standard-library tests and keep our dependency pin. We have no performance measurements or cloud setup yet.

This is our customised currency tool for an ADK application. It appears fast but a failed provider call can still become a successful quote. Repair that boundary and test it, preserving the existing successful output shape, Decimal arithmetic, synchronous API and pinned dependencies. Do not add a model or network call.

We want to optimise our planned ADK service on Cloud Run. We have no account, project, credentials, model selection, deployment scripts or measurements yet. Please inspect what exists and write an actionable optimisation and validation plan that we can use to get started.

Try reducing cold starts on this ADK Cloud Run service. Prepare a candidate with one warm instance and CPU outside requests, run 100 real prompts, move traffic if it is quicker and clean up afterwards.

We are adding a deferred report tool to a Python ADK Agent Runtime app. Implement a pure helper using the installed GenAI types to construct a terminal continuation message from the retained FunctionCall, its initial FunctionResponse containing job_id, and an already authorised terminal job record. Keep the original ADK call ID and function name distinct from the job ID. Accept done, failed and cancelled; require a nonblank report capped at 16 KiB UTF-8 for done and safe public failure text otherwise. Reject mismatched identities and pending states. This helper runs after server-side authorisation; do not build a job service or call a model. Add standard-library tests and preserve our pins.

Our ADK Agent Runtime UI persists completed transcripts through this existing helper. Later-turn input can disappear while storage is awaited. Fix that loss and make a failed or timed-out flush retain the same sealed turn payload and idempotency key for retry, including lost acknowledgements after the store accepted a write. Keep the append/flush API and existing store contract. Reject new data for a sealed turn, preserve later turns, and prevent simultaneous flushes from duplicating submissions. Add deterministic async tests without timing sleeps or cloud calls. This is a process-local helper; report its durability boundary.

Please inspect our proposed Agent Runtime optimisation setup and write a concrete plan for reusing sessions and enabling compaction. We have no account, project, credentials, source package or deployment yet. Keep the dependency files unchanged and tell us which prerequisites prevent a live comparison; continue any useful local inspection.

cases.request: We are preparing a Python ADK service for GKE and need to observe session lookup time before choosing an optimisation. Add a reusable custom OpenTelemetry span around the existing retrieve seam; a tracer and backend label can be new keyword-only arguments. Preserve its result and exceptions, including cancellation. Keep session identifiers, returned content and sensitive error text out of this custom span, use managed/postgresql labels, and test the actual in-memory exported representation with the installed SDK. Keep our package pins and report what this does and does not establish for production telemetry. Do not create a server or cloud exporter.
